## Blog Post to X
Posts one line to X as the site's account whenever something is published (2026-11-12). Called by Agent 5 (blog posts and the weekly digest) with `{title, excerpt, url, kind, waitSeconds}`; answers at once. It waits `waitSeconds` first (6 minutes from Agent 5) so the page exists on the site before X fetches the link preview. If X refuses (for example no credits), this workflow fails and the error workflow sends one alert line. The blog post is already published by then and is not affected.
